title: Deploy a model behind an API
outcome: A tested API that serves predictions from a documented model.
steps: Prepare a small public dataset and establish a baseline.
Train and evaluate a model; document the metric you actually measured.
Expose prediction through a validated API and write setup instructions.

title: Build an image classifier
outcome: A reproducible image-classification project with evaluation and a clear README.
steps: Choose a small, license-appropriate image dataset.
Build a training and validation pipeline in PyTorch.
Compare results with a baseline and describe limitations honestly.

title: Create a sales insights dashboard
outcome: A concise dashboard with documented questions, queries, and findings.
steps: Select an open dataset and write questions before analysis.
Clean and query the data, recording assumptions.
Build a dashboard and summarize findings without overstating causation.

title: Explore product retention cohorts
outcome: A reproducible cohort analysis notebook with clearly explained measures.
steps: Define an event and cohort rule for an open dataset.
Use SQL and Pandas to calculate cohort retention.
Visualize patterns and document caveats in the data.

title: Build an accessible analytics dashboard
outcome: A responsive dashboard that can be navigated by keyboard and screen reader.
steps: Sketch key states and semantic page structure.
Build responsive components with visible focus and keyboard support.
Test contrast, narrow screens, and empty/error states.

title: Publish a small UI component library
outcome: Documented and tested reusable components with accessible variants.
steps: Choose three components with clear interaction contracts.
Implement typed props and keyboard-accessible states.
Add focused tests and usage documentation.

title: Design a task management API
outcome: A documented API with validation, persistence, and meaningful tests.
steps: Design resources and validation rules before coding.
Implement CRUD routes backed by a small database.
Add tests and document authorization and error behavior.
